verdict.rationale: Accounting and ERP integration is a fair question for a business payments account, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no native ERP connector and no bidirectional sync. Statement exports in accounting formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF) and webhook subscriptions are one-way or developer building blocks a team could use to construct a sync, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries
